designationHistory.name: Opal Creek Scenic Recreation Area
designationHistory.indexText: Congress established the Opal Creek Wilderness and the Opal Creek Scenic Recreation Area in the Willamette National Forest, Oregon.

authority.citation: Public Law 104-208, div. B, title I, 110 Stat. 3009-523; re-enacted by Public Law 104-333, div. I, title X, sec. 1023, 110 Stat. 4215 (Nov. 12, 1996)

designationHistory.note: The U.S. Code codifies the Nov. 12, 1996 enactment (Public Law 104-333, sec. 1023) and notes that substantially identical provisions were first enacted Sept. 30, 1996 by Public Law 104-208.
